run_ORPO_training: run ORPO training on a causal language model with a preference dataset
create_ORPO_trainer: create an ORPOTrainer with a model, dataset, tokenizer, and training configuration
build_ORPO_config: build an ORPOConfig with training hyperparameters like learning rate and batch size
run_ORPO_with_PEFT: run ORPO training with PEFT LoRA adapters for parameter-efficient fine-tuning
save_push_model: save and push a trained ORPO model to the Hugging Face Hub
